visualCharacteristics: Grid of bordered tiles (3-up desktop), image or icon on top, title and text below; optional heading/intro row; Style options solutions, productlines, insights, simple, features.
reuseGuidance: Use for wrapping grids of look-alike linked items with an image or icon.

contentPattern.structure: row 1: optional heading/intro text; then one row per card: image or icon cell, text cell with linked title (H3/H4) and description
